requirement: P6 鈥?Regression Sentinel (baseline 鈫?candidate; report only, never modify production code)
summary: Added a report-only regression sentinel that captures a snapshot of the nine dimensions the plan names (acceptance digest and per-check phases, test counts, exported interface signatures, declared schema surface, benchmark metrics, provider success rates, file-format inventory, dependency versions and build sizes) and compares baseline 鈫?candidate with a verdict per difference: REGRESSION, DRIFT, IMPROVEMENT, INFO or UNAVAILABLE. It modifies nothing: there is no flag that applies a change, and a dimension that only one side measured is UNAVAILABLE rather than evidence of stability.
implementation: src/shared/regression-sentinel.ts (pure): SENTINEL_DIMENSIONS; SentinelSnapshot/SentinelFinding/SentinelReport with policy REPORT_ONLY; compareAcceptance (per-check phases with a strictness rank, a vanished check counted as lost coverage, plus digest and overall); compareTests (fewer tests is a regression, added tests informational); compareInterfaces (removed or reshaped export is drift); compareSchemas; compareBenchmarks respecting each metric's own direction; compareProviderSuccess with a tolerance; compareFileFormats; compareDependencies (major change is drift); compareBuildSize with a relative tolerance; compareSnapshots; buildSentinelReport failing only on a regression (drift reports without failing); renderSentinelReport

electron/host/sentinel-capture.ts: captureFileSurface (exported functions/classes/consts/enums plus declared type/interface names, from source text rather than compiled output); normalizeSignature so formatting churn is not drift; captureInterfaces/captureSchemas over src/shared and electron; captureAcceptance reading the P1 record (BOM-tolerant); captureBenchmarks; captureProviderSuccess derived from telemetry rows rather than asserted; captureBuildOutput; captureDependencies (BOM-tolerant); captureSnapshot with per-dimension isolation that records an unmeasurable dimension in `unavailable[]` instead of omitting it; read/write/tryRead snapshot
scripts/host-regression.cjs: --capture, --baseline, --candidate, --tests F,T,X, --update-baseline, --json, --out. Exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL (a regression), 4 DRIFT
defects_found_by_this_evidence: a whole-dimension absence and an optional sub-field absence were conflated: omitting per-suite test counts produced a spurious 'the baseline has no measurement for this dimension' finding on every run. Fixed with compareOptionalMap, which reports nothing when an optional sub-map was simply not recorded while still reporting UNAVAILABLE when the dimension itself is absent
the capture accepted a `tests` measurement but never stored it, so a captured baseline always reported the tests dimension as UNAVAILABLE. Fixed by adding `tests` to the capture options
tests: tests/unit/host-regression-sentinel.test.ts (30 tests): the nine declared dimensions; a failed acceptance check is a regression and a vanished one is lost coverage while an improved one is an improvement; a missing acceptance record is UNAVAILABLE; removed tests regression / added tests informational / fewer files drift; an absent optional sub-field produces no finding while present per-suite counts are compared; removed and reshaped exports are drift and added ones informational; removed declared types are schema drift; each benchmark metric's direction is respected; provider success beyond tolerance is a regression and within tolerance is silent; a vanished or halved file format is drift; a major dependency change is drift and a patch change informational; abnormal build size growth is drift; a dimension only one side measured is UNAVAILABLE; missingDimensions lists every unmeasured dimension; the verdict fails on a regression, reports drift, and passes clean; summary and rendering; capture 鈥?signature normalization, exported-surface extraction from real source text, test files skipped, the P1 acceptance record read including a BOM-prefixed one and a non-record rejected, provider success derived from telemetry, benchmarks from the first existing candidate, build formats and sizes from a real output tree, dependencies from package.json, a full capture that writes nothing into the tree and lists its unmeasured dimensions, a snapshot round trip that refuses a foreign file, and an end-to-end baseline鈫抍andidate run that reports the removed test, the reshaped export, the dropped schema and the major dependency change

notes: The sentinel is deliberately not wired into any merge gate: the plan says report only, and a sentinel that could block a merge would be a controller. The benchmark dimension is UNAVAILABLE here because artifacts/benchmark.json is not present; the P1 acceptance hub can produce it (tenx:benchmark), after which the dimension captures on its own.
